def ensure_interior_light(session):
    """An opaque RGBD ceiling needs lighting below it; resets are idempotent."""
    spec = getattr(session, "cfg", {}).get("background", {}).get("interior_light")
    if not spec:
        return
    from pxr import Gf, UsdGeom, UsdLux

    stage = session.wf.world.stage
    light = UsdLux.RectLight.Define(stage, session.wf.task.root_prim_path + "/quality_ceiling_light")
    light.CreateIntensityAttr(float(spec["intensity"]))
    light.CreateWidthAttr(float(spec["width"]))
    light.CreateHeightAttr(float(spec["height"]))
    # Preserve legacy snapshots by default. Interior production lighting can
    # use luminance independent of the area of the ceiling panel.
    light.CreateNormalizeAttr(bool(spec.get("normalize", True)))
    UsdGeom.XformCommonAPI(light).SetTranslate(Gf.Vec3d(*spec["translation"]))
    print("[quarc] restored interior light below RGBD ceiling", flush=True)

def step():
        nonlocal steps
        original_step()
        steps += 1
        if steps % 10 == 0:
            capture()

    try:
        capture()
        env.scene.step = step
        result = env.play_once()
        task_success = bool(env.check_success())
    finally:
        env.scene.step = original_step
    if not task_success:
        writer.h5.close()

def restore_state(model, data, state, mujoco):
    if len(state) != 1 + model.nq + model.nv + model.na:
        raise ValueError("recorded state width differs from compiled MJCF")
    data.time = float(state[0])
    data.qpos[:] = state[1:1 + model.nq]
    data.qvel[:] = state[1 + model.nq:1 + model.nq + model.nv]
    if model.na:
        data.act[:] = state[-model.na:]
    mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
    actual = np.concatenate(([data.time], data.qpos, data.qvel, data.act))
    error = float(np.max(np.abs(actual - state)))
